facts: 提醒计划保存在本机；本应用不提供云同步或云备份。

privacy.title: 隐私政策
privacy.description: 个人开发者、Google SDK、数据用途、保存与删除。
privacy.summary: 本机提醒无需登录。这里说明广告、购买、可选统计与诊断如何处理数据，以及你可以管理的选择。

sections.title: 1. 应用与个人开发者
paragraphs: 「循环闹钟（Recurring Alarm）」Android 应用（包名 com.lusanyuss.compoundbell）由余柳以个人开发者身份提供并运营，余柳负责本政策所述的应用数据处理。隐私与服务联系邮箱：lusanyuss@gmail.com。

sections.title: 2. 本机提醒与权限
paragraphs: 提醒计划、标题、备注、金额、目标和时刻保存在当前设备，供创建、展示及执行提醒使用；不上传到开发者的账号服务器，也不作为广告或统计事件内容发送。本应用无需注册或登录，不提供自建账号、云同步或应用内云备份。
Android 通知、准时闹钟、锁屏显示、振动及前台播放等能力用于执行提醒。为在重启或首次解锁前恢复提醒，系统所需的最小提醒信息会保存在设备保护存储中。你可在系统设置管理权限，拒绝或撤销权限可能影响送达。

sections.title: 3. AdMob 广告与隐私选择
paragraphs: 免费版本可使用 Google AdMob 展示广告。Google 广告 SDK 可处理 IP 地址（可推断大致位置）、设备或可用的账号相关标识（例如广告 ID、应用集 ID）、广告展示与点击等交互，以及性能和诊断信息，用于广告投放、衡量及反欺诈；实际处理受 SDK、设备设置和适用隐私选择影响。广告 SDK 的诊断处理与应用内可选崩溃诊断开关分别管理。
应用通过 Google UMP 在适用地区提供同意流程；需要时，可从「我的 → 广告隐私选项」管理选择。你也可通过 Android 设置管理广告标识。购买并核实去广告权益后，应用停止新的广告请求并移除广告位；此前已发送给服务商的数据不会因此自动删除。

sections.title: 4. 一次性去广告购买
paragraphs: Google Play 处理结算与购买记录。本应用处理商品标识、购买状态及商店返回的购买凭证，用于校验、确认和恢复去广告权益；不获取你的 Google 账号密码或完整银行卡资料。
为减少启动等待，应用在本机安全存储上次已核实的权益状态，并在后台查询商店更新。此缓存不保存订单凭据，不用于跨账号或跨商店共享。待付款不授予已购买权益；退款或撤销按后续成功查询到的商店结果处理。

sections.title: 5. 可选使用统计与崩溃诊断
paragraphs: 「我的 → 使用情况与诊断」提供独立的使用统计和崩溃诊断选择，两项默认开启，可随时独立关闭；允许时由对应 Firebase Analytics 或 Crashlytics 采集。数据可包括应用安装实例标识、版本、设备及系统信息、有限功能事件、错误类型和诊断堆栈，用于分析功能使用和修复问题。Firebase Analytics 还可能自动记录一次性去广告的购买事件，包括商品标识、名称和价格等交易统计。
应用不将提醒标题、用药详情、金额、备注、密码或购买令牌作为这些统计与诊断的上报内容。关闭对应选择会停止新的采集，并请求删除尚未发送的崩溃报告；已经发送的数据不会被本机开关自动删除。广告 SDK 的处理不由这两个开关控制。

sections.title: 意见反馈与应用评价
paragraphs: 在「我的 → 意见反馈」主动提交时，应用会将反馈类型、文字内容、选填的联系邮箱，以及应用版本与构建号、手机型号、系统版本、界面语言和提交时间发送到 Google Firebase。Firebase 匿名身份仅用于保护和去重反馈，无需你注册或登录，不读取 Google 账号邮箱。匿名身份及网络信息也可能由 Google 为认证、安全和服务运行处理。反馈不会公开展示，也不会作为广告或统计事件发送。首版不上传图片、提醒计划或购买凭证；请勿在反馈中填写密码、验证码或支付信息。草稿保存在本机，提交后仅保留处理反馈与必要法定义务所需的时间。可通过 lusanyuss@gmail.com 联系开发者请求删除，并提供你提交时的联系信息或反馈内容供核对。「评价应用」会打开 Google Play，评价内容和公开范围由 Google Play 管理。

sections.title: 6. 接收方、保存期限与安全
paragraphs: Google 及其适用服务提供方处理广告、结算和经选择启用的统计或诊断数据，可能在你所在国家或地区之外处理。开发者不出售你的本机提醒内容。支持邮件由邮件服务提供方处理，请勿发送密码、验证码、完整银行卡资料或购买令牌。
本机提醒通常保存至你删除计划、清除应用数据或卸载；系统备份或设备迁移可能独立保留副本，具体取决于设备设置，本应用不提供云端备份管理。权益缓存供本机恢复使用；删除缓存不等于撤销 Google Play 购买。支持邮件仅在处理请求、后续沟通及必要法定义务所需期间保留，不再需要时删除。
Google 侧数据的保存及删除按相应服务的政策和配置执行。例如，Google 说明 Crashlytics 的崩溃堆栈及相关标识通常在保存 90 天后开始从在线和备份系统中删除；Analytics 的事件保留按服务配置执行。你可以联系开发者提出访问或删除请求，处理范围取决于可识别的数据、服务商能力和适用法律。
本机数据使用 Android 应用隔离，权益缓存使用系统安全存储；Google SDK 通信采用其传输安全机制。我们限制处理为提供功能所必要的范围，但不承诺任何存储或网络绝对安全。

sections.title: 7. 数据管理与隐私权利
paragraphs: 你可编辑或删除本机计划、管理系统权限、调整广告隐私选项，以及分别撤回统计和诊断选择。依适用法律，你也可通过上述邮箱请求访问、更正、删除或限制处理相关个人信息。为处理请求，我们可能仅核实必要信息；如涉及 Google 独立持有的数据，可能需要使用 Google 提供的隐私管理渠道。
本版没有 App 登录、退出登录或新建账号功能。若曾使用历史测试版账号，撤下登录入口不等于旧服务已经删除历史数据或撤销 Google 授权；可联系开发者核实并处理。数据管理页保留相应说明。
links: 管理 Google 账号隐私

sections.title: 8. 未成年人、更新与联系
paragraphs: 未成年人使用须符合所在地适用法律，并在法律要求时取得监护人同意。如发现儿童信息被不当处理，请联系开发者。
本政策自 2026 年 10 月 26 日更新生效。数据处理发生实质变化时，会更新说明，并在适用法律要求时告知或重新取得同意。联系：余柳，lusanyuss@gmail.com。

terms.title: 用户协议
terms.description: 个人开发者的服务范围、提醒限制、一次性购买和退款。
terms.summary: 免费使用本机提醒，可通过 Google Play 一次性购买去广告；没有会员订阅或自动续费。

sections.title: 1. 服务提供者与适用范围
paragraphs: 本协议适用于余柳以个人开发者身份提供并运营的「循环闹钟（Recurring Alarm）」Android 应用（com.lusanyuss.compoundbell）。服务及隐私联系邮箱：lusanyuss@gmail.com。请在使用前了解本协议及隐私政策。

sections.title: 2. 提醒功能与使用限制
paragraphs: 应用帮助安排日常、投资、用药、运动、学习及自定义习惯的本机提醒，不提供自动交易、个性化投资建议、收益保证、医疗诊断或治疗建议。请自行核对重要提醒；涉及健康或安全的事项，应保留其他可靠保障。
通知与准时闹钟权限、设备后台限制、音量、勿扰、锁屏策略、关机、系统时间和时区均可能影响提醒。交易日规则仅在已核实日历覆盖范围内可用，未知日期不按普通工作日推测。Android 响铃可手动停止，当前上限约一分钟；系统或设备限制仍可能影响实际行为。

sections.title: 3. 本机使用与数据
paragraphs: 核心功能无需注册或登录。计划保存在当前设备，不提供应用账号、云同步、应用内云备份或跨设备计划恢复。请自行保管重要信息；清除数据、卸载及系统备份或迁移可能影响本机数据。数据处理和选择详见隐私政策。

sections.title: 4. 广告与一次性去广告
paragraphs: 免费版本可显示广告。在提供购买的版本和地区，你可通过 Google Play 一次性购买永久去广告；这是非消耗型买断，不是会员订阅，没有自动续费。实际价格、币种及税费以购买前 Google Play 展示为准。
商店确认并经应用核实购买后，停止新的广告请求并移除应用内全部广告位。待付款或未核实的交易不视为已购买。恢复购买依赖拥有该商品的 Google Play 账号及商店核实，不要求 App 登录，不承诺跨商店或跨账号共享。
重新安装或更换设备后，可在对应商店账号下使用「恢复购买」。本机缓存有助于已核实用户的启动体验，但不替代商店购买记录。退款或撤销后，权益按商店核实结果更新；查询失败不会自动认定退款。

sections.title: 5. 退款与消费者权利
paragraphs: 购买、结算及退款适用 Google Play 的相关规则和当地消费者保护法律；你也可通过联系邮箱提出购买问题。卸载应用不会自动办理退款。本协议不排除或限制适用法律规定的消费者权利或不能免责的责任。

sections.title: 6. 合理使用、更新与支持
paragraphs: 请合法使用应用，不干扰系统或他人权益。功能调整或本协议实质更新时，会更新日期和相关说明，并依法履行必要通知或同意义务。未成年人须遵守当地法律并在需要时取得监护人同意。
本协议于 2026 年 10 月 26 日更新生效。请通过 lusanyuss@gmail.com 联系余柳，说明应用版本、设备和问题，不要发送密码、验证码、完整银行卡资料或购买令牌。

deletion.title: 数据管理与删除
deletion.description: 管理本机计划、隐私选择、购买记录和历史测试数据。
deletion.summary: 本版没有 App 账号。删除本机数据与处理 Google 或历史服务记录是不同操作。

sections.title: 1. 本机计划与隐私选择
paragraphs: 你可在应用中删除提醒计划，或通过 Android 设置清除应用数据、卸载应用。系统备份和迁移可能保留副本，请在设备设置中管理。可分别关闭使用统计与崩溃诊断；广告隐私选项在需要时可从「我的」进入。关闭选择不会自动删除已发送给服务商的数据。

sections.title: 2. Google Play 购买
paragraphs: 清除数据或卸载不取消非消耗型购买，也不会自动申请退款。使用拥有该商品的 Google Play 账号可尝试恢复购买。Google 购买记录、退款及账号隐私应通过相应 Google 渠道管理。

sections.title: 3. 历史测试数据与请求
paragraphs: 本版不提供 App 登录，也不再连接历史 Supabase 或 RevenueCat 账号服务。撤下入口不证明旧服务已删除测试数据或 Google 授权已撤销。若曾参与旧版测试，请通过 lusanyuss@gmail.com 联系余柳，核实历史数据及依法可执行的删除请求；实际结果以处理回执为准。

sections.title: 4. 隐私联系
paragraphs: 请联系个人开发者余柳：lusanyuss@gmail.com，说明需要管理的数据及请求类型。我们仅核实处理所必需的信息，不要发送密码、验证码、完整银行卡资料或购买令牌。

paragraphs: 「循环闹钟（Recurring Alarm）」由余柳以个人开发者身份提供并运营。请通过 lusanyuss@gmail.com 联系，说明应用版本、设备型号、系统版本、问题和复现步骤。涉及购买时，可先在拥有商品的 Google Play 账号下使用「恢复购买」。不要发送密码、验证码、完整付款资料或购买令牌。

en.scope: Scope: Recurring Alarm for Android; no app sign-in, local reminders, ads, one-time ad removal, and optional analytics and diagnostics.
facts: Reminder plans stay on your device; no app cloud sync or backup is offered.
Google services handle ads and optional analytics; manage choices as described.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Individual developer, Google SDKs, data use, retention and deletion.
privacy.summary: Local reminders need no sign-in. Learn how ads, purchases, optional analytics and diagnostics process data, and how to manage your choices.

sections.title: 1. App and individual developer
paragraphs: Recurring Alarm (循环闹钟), Android package com.lusanyuss.compoundbell, is provided and operated by 余柳 as an individual developer. 余柳 is responsible for the app data processing described in this policy. Privacy and service contact: lusanyuss@gmail.com.

sections.title: 2. Local reminders and permissions
paragraphs: Reminder plans, titles, notes, amounts, goals and times are stored on your device to create, display and run reminders. They are not uploaded to a developer account server or sent as advertising or analytics event content. No app registration or sign-in is required. The app offers no hosted accounts, cloud synchronization or in-app cloud backup.

Android notifications, exact alarms, lock-screen display, vibration and foreground playback support reminders. Minimal reminder information needed to restore alarms after a restart or before the first unlock is stored in device-protected storage. You control permissions in system settings; denying or revoking them may affect delivery.

sections.title: 3. AdMob ads and privacy choices
paragraphs: The free version may display Google AdMob ads. The Google advertising SDK may process IP addresses, which can indicate approximate location, device or available account-related identifiers such as advertising or app-set IDs, ad impressions and interactions, and performance or diagnostic information for advertising, measurement and fraud prevention. Actual processing depends on the SDK, device settings and applicable privacy choices. Advertising SDK diagnostics are separate from the optional app crash-reporting switch.

Google UMP presents consent choices where applicable. When required, My → Ad privacy options lets you manage them. Android settings also offer advertising identifier controls. Once an ad-removal purchase is verified, the app stops new ad requests and removes ad placements. This does not automatically delete data already sent to a provider.

sections.title: 4. One-time ad-removal purchase
paragraphs: Google Play handles checkout and purchase records. The app processes product identifiers, purchase status and store-provided purchase evidence to verify, acknowledge and restore ad-removal access. It does not obtain your Google password or full bank card details.

To reduce startup delays, the app keeps the last verified entitlement state in local secure storage and refreshes it from the store in the background. This cache contains no order credentials and does not provide cross-account or cross-store access. Pending payment does not grant ownership. Refunds or revocations take effect when a subsequent successful store query confirms them.

sections.title: 5. Optional usage analytics and crash reports
paragraphs: My → Usage and diagnostics provides independent usage analytics and crash-reporting choices. Both are on by default and can be turned off independently. While the relevant choice is enabled, Firebase Analytics or Crashlytics processes installation-instance identifiers, app version, device and system information, limited feature events, error types or diagnostic stacks to understand app use and fix problems. Firebase Analytics may also automatically record one-time ad-removal purchase events, including product identifiers, names and prices for transaction analytics.

The app does not submit reminder titles, medication details, amounts, notes, passwords or purchase tokens as analytics or crash-report content. Turning a choice off stops new collection and requests deletion of unsent crash reports; it does not automatically erase data already sent. These switches do not control the advertising SDK.

sections.title: Feedback and app reviews
paragraphs: When you choose My → Send feedback and submit, the app sends the category, message, optional contact email, app version and build number, device model, OS version, interface language and submission time to Google Firebase. A Firebase anonymous identity protects feedback access and supports duplicate prevention; no registration or sign-in is required and the app does not read your Google account email. Google may also process anonymous identity and network information for authentication, security and service operation. Feedback is not public and is not submitted as advertising or analytics events. This version uploads no images, reminder plans or purchase evidence; do not include passwords, verification codes or payment information. Drafts are stored on your device. Submitted feedback is retained only as needed to handle the request and meet necessary legal obligations. Contact lusanyuss@gmail.com to request deletion, providing the contact information or feedback text you submitted for identification. Rate app opens Google Play, which manages review content and visibility.

sections.title: 6. Recipients, retention and security
paragraphs: Google and its applicable service providers process advertising, checkout, and optionally enabled analytics or diagnostics, potentially outside your country or region. The developer does not sell your local reminder content. Email providers process support messages; do not send passwords, verification codes, full card details or purchase tokens.

Local reminders normally remain until you delete plans, clear app data or uninstall. Operating-system backup or device transfer may retain copies depending on your settings; this app does not manage cloud backups. Entitlement cache supports local recovery; deleting it does not revoke a Google Play purchase. Support messages are retained only as needed to handle requests, follow up and meet necessary legal obligations, then deleted.

Google-side retention and deletion follow the relevant service policies and settings. For example, Google states that Crashlytics starts removing crash stacks and associated identifiers from live and backup systems after 90 days. Analytics event retention follows the service configuration. You may contact the developer about access or deletion; the available action depends on identifiable data, provider capabilities and applicable law.

Local data uses Android app isolation, and entitlement state uses system secure storage. Google SDKs use their transport-security mechanisms. Processing is limited to what the features need, but no storage or network can be guaranteed absolutely secure.

sections.title: 7. Data controls and privacy rights
paragraphs: You can edit or delete local plans, manage permissions and advertising privacy options, and independently withdraw analytics or crash-reporting choices. Subject to applicable law, contact the email above to request access, correction, deletion or restriction of processing. Only necessary information may be requested to verify and handle your request. For data held independently by Google, you may need to use Google privacy controls.

This version has no app sign-in, sign-out or account creation. If you used an earlier test account, retiring sign-in does not prove that a former provider deleted historical data or that Google authorization was revoked. Contact the developer to check and handle such requests. The data-management page retains this information.

sections.title: 8. Minors, changes and contact
paragraphs: Use by minors must comply with local law and obtain guardian consent where required. Contact the developer if you believe information about a child has been handled improperly.

This policy is updated and effective October 26, 2026. Material processing changes will be described in an update, with notice or renewed consent where applicable law requires it. Contact: 余柳, lusanyuss@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Individual provider, reminder limitations, one-time purchase and refunds.
terms.summary: Use local reminders for free, with optional one-time Google Play ad removal and no membership subscription or automatic renewal.

sections.title: 1. Provider and scope
paragraphs: These terms cover the Android app Recurring Alarm (循环闹钟), com.lusanyuss.compoundbell, provided and operated by 余柳 as an individual developer. Service and privacy contact: lusanyuss@gmail.com. Please review these terms and the Privacy Policy before use.

sections.title: 2. Reminders and limitations
paragraphs: The app schedules local reminders for daily routines, investing, medication, exercise, learning and custom habits. It does not offer automatic trading, personalized investment advice, guaranteed returns, medical diagnosis or treatment advice. Independently check important reminders and keep other reliable safeguards for health or safety needs.

Notification and exact-alarm permissions, background restrictions, volume, do-not-disturb settings, lock-screen policies, shutdowns, system time and time zones can affect reminders. Trading-day rules use only verified calendar coverage, without guessing unknown dates from ordinary weekdays. Android ringing can be stopped manually and currently has an approximately one-minute limit; system or device restrictions may affect actual behavior.

sections.title: 3. Local use and data
paragraphs: Core features require no registration or sign-in. Plans stay on this device. The app offers no hosted accounts, cloud sync, in-app cloud backup or cross-device plan recovery. Keep your own copies of important information. Clearing data, uninstalling, system backup or device transfer may affect local data. See the Privacy Policy for data handling and choices.

sections.title: 4. Ads and one-time ad removal
paragraphs: The free version may display ads. Where offered, Google Play provides a one-time, non-consumable purchase to permanently remove ads. This is not a membership subscription and does not renew automatically. The price, currency and taxes shown by Google Play before purchase apply.

After the store confirms and the app verifies the purchase, the app stops new ad requests and removes all in-app ad placements. Pending or unverified transactions do not count as ownership. Restore requires the Google Play account that owns the product and store verification; no app sign-in is needed. Cross-store or cross-account sharing is not promised.

After reinstalling or changing devices, use Restore purchase with the appropriate store account. Local cache improves startup for previously verified owners but does not replace store purchase records. Refunds or revocations update access when confirmed by the store; a query failure alone is not treated as a refund.

sections.title: 5. Refunds and consumer rights
paragraphs: Purchases, checkout and refunds follow applicable Google Play rules and local consumer-protection law. You may also contact the developer with purchase issues. Uninstalling does not automatically request a refund. These terms do not exclude statutory consumer rights or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

sections.title: 6. Acceptable use, changes and support
paragraphs: Use the app lawfully without interfering with systems or others’ rights. Material feature or term changes will update the date and explanations, with notice or consent where required by law. Minors must comply with local law and obtain guardian consent where required.

These terms are updated and effective October 26, 2026. Contact 余柳 at lusanyuss@gmail.com with the app version, device and issue. Do not send passwords, verification codes, full card details or purchase tokens.

deletion.title: Data management & deletion
deletion.description: Manage local plans, privacy choices, purchase records and historical test data.
deletion.summary: This version has no app accounts. Local deletion and records held by Google or former services require different actions.

sections.title: 1. Local plans and privacy choices
paragraphs: Delete reminder plans in the app, or clear data or uninstall through Android settings. System backup or device transfer may retain copies; manage these in device settings. Usage analytics and crash reporting can be turned off independently. Advertising privacy options appear in My when required. Turning a choice off does not automatically erase data already sent to a provider.

sections.title: 2. Google Play purchases
paragraphs: Clearing data or uninstalling does not cancel a non-consumable purchase or request a refund. Use the Google Play account that owns the product to attempt restoration. Manage Google purchase records, refunds and account privacy through the relevant Google channels.

sections.title: 3. Historical test data and requests
paragraphs: This version has no app sign-in and no longer connects to former Supabase or RevenueCat account services. Retiring these interfaces does not prove deletion of historical test data or revocation of Google authorization. If you used an earlier test account, contact 余柳 at lusanyuss@gmail.com to check historical data and legally available deletion actions. Actual results depend on the completed handling record.

sections.title: 4. Privacy contact
paragraphs: Contact individual developer 余柳 at lusanyuss@gmail.com with the relevant data and request type. Only necessary verification information will be requested. Do not send passwords, verification codes, full card details or purchase tokens.
